title: Riverbend Patient Financial Services Policy: Adding New Balances to an Open Patient Payment Plan
content:
**1. Allowance.** A newly billed eligible balance may be added to an open **Patient Payment Plan** only on tiers that allow add-ons and when fewer add-ons were enrolled on the plan in the rolling 12 months than the tier's add-on allowance. The rolling 12 months end on the day of the decision and run from the same calendar date one year earlier, inclusive; the add-ons counted are the distinct enrollment dates on the plan that are later than the plan's offered date.

**2. Recomputation.** The clause "The installment is then recomputed (add-on recalculation basis): the remaining schedule is the number of scheduled installments extended by the tier's add-on term extension, but never beyond the maximum term, less the installments already paid; the new installment is the new plan balance divided by that remaining schedule, rounded half-up to the cent, never below the minimum monthly payment" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**3. Tier overflow.** When the add-on would take the plan balance above the tier's maximum enrolled balance, it is not added: the patient is offered a new plan on the tier matching the combined balance, which requires cancelling the open plan first.

### Counting add-ons (clause 1), hypothetical

A plan offered on the 5th of March holds enrollments dated the 5th of March (at creation), the 20th of June (two accounts that day) and the 2nd of November. On a decision date of the 1st of February of the next year, the add-on dates counted are the 20th of June and the 2nd of November: 2 add-ons, since enrollments on one date count once and the creation-date enrollments are not add-ons. On a tier allowing 2 add-ons in rolling 12 months, a further add-on is not within the allowance; on a tier allowing 3, it is.

superseded_clauses: The installment is then recomputed (add_on_recalc_basis): the remaining schedule is term_months extended by add_on_term_extension_months, but never beyond max_term_months, less the installments already paid; the new installment is the new plan balance divided by that remaining schedule, rounded half-up to the cent, never below min_monthly_payment_usd.
